lessons_used: Predictions were generally overly optimistic overall, but underestimated gains for winning tests.

Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder), home notifications (home, notification), adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow), choose path layouts (choose_path, layout), and finish new flows (finish, new_flow) proved helpful, generating multiple winning tests.
New finish screens (finish, new_screen) and finish redesigns (finish, redesign) consistently led to negative impacts or guardrail rollbacks across multiple tests.

Finish hints (finish, hint), finish incentives (finish, incentive), home hints (home, hint), sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), choose path copy (choose_path, copy), and sign-in notifications (sign_in, notification) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.

Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once (including adoption incentive, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint/incentive/new_flow, sign_in layout, and sign_in new_flow), requiring at least 2 tests to state a pattern.

candidates.title: Reorder Sign In After Pick Friend Screen
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to immediately follow pet selection on the pick friend screen so account creation locks in the chosen pet.
candidates.why: Support emails show 8 reports of missing/reset pets after sign-in, and sign-in reordering has proven effective in past iterations.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Selected Companion
sign_in.body: Sign in now to sync your new pet choice across your devices.

guard.reason: Reordering sign in within onboarding is allowed under rule 4 and preserves all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 8 support emails regarding reset pets and uses sign_in reordering which is a proven winner.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Interactive Voice Preview Flow
candidates.change: Add audio play buttons and animated preview components to pet option cards so users can sample companion sound effects before adopting.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 24.3% drop-off and high completion time (median 89s). Interactive adoption flows have yielded positive historic gains.

guard.reason: Adding interactive voice preview components to pick_friend is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targets high drop-off step (24.3%) with a new flow pattern that has generated past wins.

candidates.title: Choose Path Checklist Layout Refresh
candidates.change: Format the choose path screen with a checklist layout so users can systematically select their preferred setup options.
candidates.why: Choose path drops off 21.5% of users. Choose path layout updates have repeatedly shown strong historical performance.

choose_path.headline: Setup Your Experience
choose_path.body: Select your preferences to customize how your desktop pet interacts with you.

guard.reason: Changing choose_path to a preferences checklist loses its required job of offering adopting vs making your own pet.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Habitat Sound Notification
candidates.change: Add an active sound alert component and desktop readiness toggle on the waiting screen to announce when habitat generation finishes.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a very high mean time (2336s). Home notification changes have proven helpful in past cycles.

guard.reason: Adding sound notification components to the waiting screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Home notification changes consistently deliver strong positive lifts (+1.3% historical).

candidates.title: Upload Photos Stage Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the custom photo upload step using a stage layout that displays real-time custom pet asset visual updates.
candidates.why: Support logged 3 emails regarding failed or malformed custom pet generations during adoption.

upload_photos.headline: Stage Your Custom Pet Photo
upload_photos.body: Upload a clear photo to generate your unique desktop pet visual avatar.

guard.reason: Redesigning the upload_photos layout retains its job and is permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Has 3 support emails, but redesign changes consistently yield negative conversion impacts (-2.6%).

candidates.title: New Choose Path Option Selection Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated companion mode selection screen after the story screen to let users pick active versus focus desktop pet behaviors.
candidates.why: Choose path is the first major funnel drop-off (21.5%). Structuring path choices into clear dedicated steps sets proper user expectations.

new_companion_mode.headline: Select Companion Interaction Mode
new_companion_mode.body: Choose whether your pet provides active desktop companionships or quiet background focus.

guard.reason: Adding a new screen inside onboarding is explicitly permitted by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens introduces extra friction and historically results in negative drop-off.

candidates.title: Home Intro Companion Audio Controls Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive audio sample and desktop controls visual preview component to the final intro screen to teach desktop controls.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about confusion on controlling or hiding the pet. Finish step new flows have historically performed well.

guard.reason: Adding visual preview and sound components to home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest drop-off step (28.6%) with direct support mail evidence and a winning new_flow pattern.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Two Column Layout Refresh
candidates.change: Switch the pet selection screen to a two-column layout showing pet animations on one side and traits on the other.
candidates.why: Adoption has a high completion time (median 89s, mean 1017s). A side-by-side comparison speeds up decision making.

pick_friend.headline: Compare Desktop Pets
pick_friend.body: Browse companion traits side by side to pick the best fit for your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning pick_friend to a two-column layout preserves pet selection while refreshing UI.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high median time on adoption, though layout changes have mixed historical results.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Habitat Status Banner Notification
candidates.change: Display an active status banner badge on the waiting screen updating users on desktop pet asset rendering progress.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about pets not opening on desktop, and home step notification features have proven helpful.

guard.reason: Adding a progress status banner to the waiting screen preserves its function and is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Solves 3 specific support reports using home notifications, a proven winning change type.

candidates.title: Choose Path Spotlight Layout Refresh
candidates.change: Rebuild the path selection screen with a spotlight layout highlighting key features of each usage path.
candidates.why: Choose path is the first drop-off point (78.5% conversion). Choose path layout changes have consistently driven historical wins.

choose_path.headline: Spotlight Your Desired Journey
choose_path.body: Explore companion path options to tailor desktop behavior.

guard.reason: Spotlight layout on choose_path retains the function of exploring companion path options.

candidates.score_note: Targets initial funnel drop-off using choose_path layout changes, which are proven winners.
